items.title: Tempus (TEM) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
items.summary: Tempus AI reported Q3 2026 revenue of $411.54 million, slightly beating consensus estimates with a 23.1% year-over-year increase. The company posted EPS of $0.07 versus expectations of -$0.09, representing a significant 177.78% positive surprise. Diagnostics revenue grew 20% YoY while Data and applications revenue increased 32.9% YoY. However, the stock has underperformed the broader market, declining 5.8% over the past month.

items.title: Tempus AI (TEM) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Tempus AI (TEM) reported quarterly earnings of $0.07 per share, beating consensus estimates of a loss of $0.09, representing a 177.78% earnings surprise. The company posted revenues of $411.54 million, surpassing estimates by 0.05% and showing year-over-year growth from $334.21 million. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. The Medical Info Systems industry ranks in the top 36% of Zacks industries.

items.title: TEM vs. DOCS: Which Medical Info Systems Stock Is the Better Pick Now?
items.summary: Tempus AI (TEM) appears more favorable than Doximity (DOCS) in the medical information systems sector. TEM is expected to deliver 23.1% Q3 revenue growth driven by oncology testing and data licensing, while trading at a lower valuation (7.32X P/S vs 8.53X P/S). DOCS faces headwinds from cautious pharma spending and margin pressure, with only 1.3% expected revenue growth and a 24.4% EPS decline, despite strong physician engagement and AI adoption.
